chapters.title: Once there was a smelly butter…
p: Once there was a smelly butter. It was so smelly that everyone around it said "yuck"! Poor butter. It felt so sad. It wanted to be like all the other butter.
One day the butter was so sad it started to cry. It cried and cried until it made a big pool of water around it.

Then suddenly the sun came out from behind the clouds. It felt really warm and made the butter happy. The water around it started to boil and the smell of the butter changed from smelly to sweet. Everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
The butter was happy and excited. It had a new smell! It was a happy end for the smelly butter.

chapters.title: Once there was a little bunny…
p: Once there was a little bunny. The bunny was very independent. The bunny liked to explore. Every day the bunny ran around the garden looking for exciting things.

One day the bunny was running around and bumped into a wall. It was a big wall and the bunny couldn't get over it. The bunny was tired from running, so it decided to rest. The bunny lay down and closed its eyes.
The bunny felt so relaxed it fell asleep. The bunny slept for a long time until it felt well-rested. Then the bunny opened its eyes and hopped away.
It was happy to be an independent bunny again, exploring the garden and running around freely.

chapters.title: One day Tom was walking down…
p: One day, Tom was walking down the street. He saw a model on the sidewalk. It was very tough and he wanted to talk to it. He approached the model, but it wouldn't answer.
Tom was puzzled, so he decided to try something else. He started to whistle, but the model wouldn't respond to that either.
Tom was getting frustrated, but then he had an idea. He started to sing and clap his hands. Suddenly, the model started to talk. It was the most amazing thing Tom had ever heard!
Tom kept singing and the model kept talking. They talked and talked and talked.
Eventually, Tom had to go home. He said good-bye to the model and promised to come and visit it again soon.

chapters.title: Molly was very angry today She…
p: Molly was very angry today. She was angry because her friend had a juice and she didn't. She saw her friend drinking it and wished she had one too.
She asked her mom if she could have something to drink, but her mom said 'not today'. Molly was even more angry. She stamped her feet and shouted 'I want something to drink!'
Molly's mom thought for a moment and then said 'I know what you can do. We can go to the store and you can pick something to drink!'
Molly was excited. She put on her coat and they went to the store. Molly chose her favorite juice and they bought it.
Molly couldn't wait to get home. When they did, she ran straight to the kitchen and poured some of her juice. She took a big drink and smiled.
Now Molly was happy again. She was no longer angry!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a friendly man. He lived in a house with a big garage. Every day he used the garage to fix his useful toys. Every week the man asked his friends to the garage. He would invite them to have a party and play with the toys he made. Everyone in the town had so much fun in the man's garage. They all enjoyed the useful toys they could play with.

One day, the man invited all of the children from the town to his garage. They were so excited to see what kinds of toys he had made. They all ran through the garage, playing and having a great time. Everyone was so happy that the man was so kind to invite them to his beautiful garage.

The man's garage was always so full of laughter and fun. Everyone in the town was grateful for the end of the day when the man invited them all to his garage. The man had the most special and useful garage of all.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a poor tiger. He was lost and alone and didn't know what to do. He was so scared and sad. Then, he heard a noise. It was a man! He was coming to rescue the tiger. The man was so kind and brave. He put the tiger in his truck and brought him to a safe place.
At the safe place the man showed the tiger his new home. It was so nice and clean! The tiger was so happy! He had a bed to sleep in and big, yummy meals to eat.

But then the tiger realized he was alone. "I miss my friends," he thought. Just then, the man came back with some other tigers. The man had rescued them too! The tigers were so happy to see each other.

The man had not just saved the tigers from being all alone, but also from a place that was disgusting. It was dirty and smelly and the food was bad. But now that the tigers were all rescued, they were safe and happy. They would never have to be scared and alone ever again!

chapters.title: Once there was a girl named…
p: Once there was a girl named Mary who was ready to go for a walk. She put on her shoes and grabbed her mama's hand.
As they walked, she saw a bright green butterfly floating in the air. She smiled and pointed excitedly at it with her thumb.

When they reached the park, she ran to the playground. She skipped over to the swings and sat down. Mama leaned down and pushed her higher and higher until she felt like she was flying with the butterfly.
At the pond, Mama showed her a new kind of bird. Together they watched it swim away.
Then it was time to go home. Mary was ready for a nap and a snack. She held her mama's hand and they walked home, smiling the whole way.

chapters.title: Once upon a Tuesday there was…
p: Once upon a Tuesday there was a boy named Jack. He was very excited because today he was going to slide. He went outside and the sun was shining brightly. Jack had a big slide in his garden and he couldn't wait to have fun.

Jack ran to the top of the slide, put his hands above his head and he started to slide. He laughed so loud. Jack slid down the slide so many times. At the end, he was so happy and smiling from ear to ear.
He went back to the top of the slide and did it again. Jack was so excited that he wanted to slide all day. He was having so much fun!
The day then came to an end and it was time for Jack to go inside. He was a bit sad, but he reminded himself that he would get to slide again on another Tuesday.

chapters.title: It was a lovely sunny day…
p: It was a lovely sunny day, so Tom and his mum decided to go for a walk to the farm. Tom was so excited to meet the animals!
First, they met a big yellow chicken. Tom tickled her under her chin and she clucked happily.
Next, they met a deaf goat. He was white and fluffy and liked eating apples from Tom's hand.
Then, they met a friendly brown cow. She liked to have her back scratched and she made lots of happy mooing sounds.
Finally, Tom and his mum said goodbye to the farm animals. It was such a fun day!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl called Molly. She was very brave and loved finding new things.
One day, Molly was looking for an adventure. She decided to go for a walk in the woods.

Suddenly, Molly heard some weird noises coming from behind a tree. She slowly walked closer and closer until she could see what was making the noise. It was a rubber! It was bouncing up and down and it looked so much fun.
Molly got closer and tried to catch the rubber, but it was bouncing away too fast. She shouted out, 'Come back here!'
Suddenly, the rubber stopped bouncing and came over to Molly. It seemed very friendly. Molly stroked its shiny, tough surface and smiled. She had finally met her new friend.
Molly took the rubber home and kept it by her bed. Every day they would go on a new adventure together. They were the best of friends.
The End

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a tall boy. He lived in a forest full of herbs. The boy loved being in the forest. Every day he went around to pick the different herbs. He became very good at it and soon he knew he was an herb expert.
He decided to use his skills to help the other animals in the forest. He created special recipes with the herbs that made the animals much happier.

One day the boy noticed a tall plant growing in the forest. He knew this was an unusual herb so he decided to try to make a recipe with it. He used special ingredients and eventually the recipe became very special. All the animals began to cheer.

The tall boy had discovered a special new herb. All the animals in the forest were very happy. They thanked him for making such a wonderful recipe. From that day on the boy was known as the Herb Master.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a hungry kangaroo. He wanted something to eat, but he didn't know what to do.
Then, he saw a big, green apple tree. He hopped over to it and started to bounce around. He saw a big, juicy apple and tried to reach it. He didn't quite get it, so he jumped higher and higher.

Finally, the kangaroo reached the apple and took a big bite. He liked the sweet taste and was very happy. He was no longer hungry! The kangaroo was so happy that he started bouncing around the tree again.

He bounced higher and higher until he reached the top of the tree. The kangaroo looked around and saw that he was the highest kangaroo in the area. He was so proud! He kept bouncing and jumping around until the sun went down.
The kangaroo had a great day and was happy he was no longer hungry.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a girl named Lily. She had a big sister named Clara who was very graceful.
Every day Clara would ask Lily for help. She would say, "Lily please help me!"
Lily always replied, "Yes, I will help you!"
So, each day Lily and Clara worked together to get things done. Clara helped Lily learn how to do things in a graceful way.
One day, Clara said to Lily, "Thank you for always being here for me. You make being graceful look so easy."
Lily smiled and replied, "I'm glad I can help my big sister."
The two of them continued to work together and they learned that no matter what, they would always have each other's backs. They knew they could rely on each other with grace.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a sailor who had a boat. He wanted to go on an adventure so he set off with his boat. Then, something bad happened. His boat split in two with a loud bang. The sailor was very sad because his boat was broken.
He was all alone and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, he saw something in the distance. It was a rainbow! He knew he had to follow it.
The sailor swam and swam, following the bright colors of the rainbow. Finally, he made it to a sunny beach. He was so happy!
The sailor was so grateful that he built a new boat from the broken pieces of his old one. Then, he set off on a new adventure in his new boat beneath the rainbow.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was an old man. He was very wise and kind. One day, the old man observed the birds in a nearby park. He watched the birds play in the trees, fly around in the sky, and make nice chirping sounds.

He closed his eyes and took in the moment. Suddenly, he remembered a time when he was a young boy. He remembered playing in the park with his friends and chasing the birds around. Those were nice memories for the old man.
He opened his eyes and saw the birds still playing in the trees. He had observed the birds again, this time with a different memory. He smiled and enjoyed the warmth of his memory.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a book. It was a special book, with lots and lots of pictures. It was so pretty.
But one day, a mean old man wanted to take the book away. He wanted to steal it. He wanted it for himself.
But the brave little girl saw him trying to steal the book. She was so brave and scared at the same time. She shouted, "No! You can't do that!"
The cold wind blew and the mean old man ran away.
Everyone was so happy. The brave little girl had saved the book.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl called Mia. She loved to collect things. Mia collected everything from socks to dolls. But her favorite thing to collect was fashion. Every day, Mia would go out looking for new outfits and dresses.

One day, Mia found the prettiest dress she had ever seen. She decided to wear it right away! But when she went out to show it off, she felt very embarrassed. All the other kids in the neighbourhood were giving her funny looks.
Mia could tell the kids did not like her fancy dress. She quickly ran home and changed out of it. She then carefully packed away her special dress and vowed never to wear it in public again.
Mia learned a valuable lesson that day. Even though it was fun to collect fashion, sometimes it is better to wear it where you can't be seen!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a girl called Mia. She wanted to explore the world, but she had to be safe. She put on her special cap, so that it could make her shine. Then Mia took a big step outside her front door.

She began to explore the world around her. She saw lots of trees and plants, some with big leaves. She heard birds singing and saw butterflies fluttering. She went to a lake and saw small fish swimming.

Mia kept going until it started to get dark. She knew it was time to go home and be safe. She put her cap back on, so it could make her shine. Then she ran back home to her mom, who gave her a big hug.
Mia was safe and happy. Wearing her cap made her shine even when it was dark. She had discovered so much and she couldn't wait to explore more. The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She wanted to make something special for her mommy.
So Lucy kneeled down and grabbed some flour, sugar, eggs and butter from the counter. She mixed them together and put the batter in the oven.
When the cake was ready, Lucy's mom put a thermometer in it. The thermometer said the cake was done!
Lucy's mom took the cake out of the oven and put it on the counter. It smelled delicious. Lucy couldn't believe it, she had made a cake!
Lucy and her mom both grinned as they took a bite of the yummy cake. It tasted just as delicious as it smelled!
Lucy was so proud of herself. She thanked her mom and hugged her tight.
The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a mummy and daddy. They were in a hurry to go somewhere special. They had to turn a special switch.
Mummy said, "Hurry up, let's turn the switch!" Daddy said, "Okay, I will try to be quick".
Daddy got to the switch and pushed it. He made a very harsh sound! Mummy jumped and said, "Oh, that was loud!"
Daddy said, "Let's go, we don't want to be late!" They both ran out of the room very fast.
At the end of the day, mummy and daddy had a great time. They made it to the special place just in time!

chapters.title: Once there was a happy gorilla…
p: Once, there was a happy gorilla. He liked to spend all day swinging around in the trees. He was so happy that all the other animals in the jungle wanted to be his friend.
One day, the gorilla decided he wanted to spend the day playing games with his new friends. He played hide and seek and tag around the trees. Everyone had lots of fun and was very happy.
The gorilla continued to spend his days playing with his friends. He was the happiest and most fun gorilla around. He loved laughing, singing and playing together.

Soon the other animals would tell their friends to come and join in the fun. Everywhere the gorilla went, he was met with lots of happy faces. He had made so many friends, he was the happiest gorilla of all.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a lab. In the lab, the people wanted to make sure things were safe. So they worked to fix things that were broken.
One day, they noticed something wasn't working right. Everyone in the lab worked hard together to figure out how to fix it.
Finally, they found a way to make the thing safe and make it work right. The people cheered and enjoyed feeling happy that they could fix the problem and make it safe.
The end.

chapters.title: One day John was very eager…
p: One day, John was very eager to receive something special. He was wondering what it could be. Suddenly, he heard a knock on the door. He ran to answer it and saw a box! He was so excited he began jumping up and down. When he opened the box, to his surprise, he found a big bowl of pasta! He couldn't believe his eyes. He was so eager to eat the pasta. He grabbed a spoon and started eating. It was the best pasta he had ever tasted! He smiled and laughed with joy. He was so happy and thankful to receive such a special gift.

chapters.title: One day a little girl was…
p: One day, a little girl was walking in the garden. Suddenly, she found a handle on the ground. She picked it up and looked at it. It was very strange. She decided to crawl with it.
She started to crawl slowly, holding the handle. She looked around but she couldn't see where it was from. As she kept crawling, the little girl felt calm.
Eventually, she saw a secret door. She looked carefully around and saw that it had two handles. One handle was very small and the other was the handle she had found.
The little girl put the handle in the right place. She was very excited when the door opened. Inside, she found a secret room with lots of presents! There was a cake, some toys, and a big balloon!
The little girl was so happy that she held the handle tightly and shouted out of joy. From then on, she kept the handle in her room as a reminder of her fun adventure.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a mountain. The mountain was huge and looked like a castle. Every day, the mountain was covered in dirt and grime.

So, every day the mountain had to be washed. Every morning, a group of children with buckets of water would march up the mountain and start washing. They washed and scrubbed the mountain until it was clean again.

The children felt so happy when they were done. They were so dizzy from scrubbing the mountain, they had to lay down and rest. But, it was worth it, because the mountain was clean and looked so beautiful!
The children cheered and cheered and cheered, until they were too tired to cheer anymore. They were so proud that they had washed the mountain!
